requests.name: a request with a fraction for its time
requests.why: JavaScript reads any number. The service refuses a time that is not a whole number, as Go and Rust do.

requests.name: a request with its time in quotes
requests.why: JavaScript compares the text as a number. The service refuses it, as Go and Rust do.

requests.name: a request without a name
requests.why: Go reads a field that is left out as empty and the viewer does not look. The service refuses a name that is not text.

requests.name: a request without a time
requests.why: Go reads a field that is left out as zero and the viewer compares nothing with a number. The service refuses it.

requests.name: a request with its signing key under a name in capitals
requests.why: Go matches a field's name without regard to case and JavaScript takes the exact name. Rust refuses a payload the two would read differently.

requests.name: a request with a second name, capitalized
requests.why: JavaScript reads the device as Phone and Go as Other: the same signed bytes, two names. Rust refuses them.

requests.name: a request with a field given twice
requests.why: JavaScript and Go take the last of two. Rust refuses a payload that says a thing twice.

requests.name: a request longer than the hosted service stores
requests.why: The service refuses a request of more than 4 KiB as text. Go and the viewer have no limit of their own.
